application.source: classification mapping required by the facts audit brief

chemistry.value: LFP (8 systems); LMO/NMC blend (6 systems); NMC (7 systems, two high-nickel)
chemistry.source: Metadata_and_Code.zip/00_Data/00_Metadata/Metadata_Systems.xlsx (released with the data), Chemistry_detail; https://doi.org/10.1038/s41560-024-01620-9, p. 1439 and SI Note 1

units_released.note: Rule: one archive per system. Released unit identifiers require package-specific inspection.

cells_leadacid.note: No lead-acid cell count applies or is exposed in this release.

cell_channels_measured.note: Monthly CSVs carry pack voltage, current, power and temperatures only.

span_unit_years.note: First to last monthly file per system (from the file names), summed over 21 systems. First-to-last includes data gaps; the paper states about 106 system-years.

obs_hours.note: Observation-hours are not used when calendar spans are measurable or no cadence is available.

files.note: 1,269 monthly CSVs held vs 1,270 stated (SI Note 2, p. 3).

fault_onset_timestamp.source: docs/descriptor/TABLE3_faults.md; released labels and metadata contain no explicit fault-onset timestamp field

sentinels_documented.source: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.12091223; public data record and released documentation state no sentinel convention
